crossRefs.note: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

translations.web: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
translations.bsb: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
translations.kjv: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
translations.asv: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
